name: NIPPON EXPRESS (SOUTH ASIA & OCEANIA) PTE. LTD.
india_angle: NX Group is set to participate in SEMICON India 2026 in New Delhi, indicating a strategic interest in the Indian semiconductor market.
summary: Nippon Express (South Asia & Oceania) Pte. Ltd. provides comprehensive logistics solutions tailored to the semiconductor industry, including delivery and storage of wafers and semiconductor parts. Their global network and specialized handling capabilities make them a key player in optimizing semiconductor supply chains.
